name: ora-smoke-consumer
description: Headless consumer smoke test that installs the packed @tdq/ora-components tarball and exercises it like a real app, catching packaging bugs the source-aliased examples app cannot see. Deliberately excluded from the root workspaces list (see root package.json) so that npm always installs a real extraction of the tarball here instead of the workspace symlink other packages resolve to, and a plain `npm install`/`npm run build`/`npm test` at the repo root never touches or needs this package's tarball dependency.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:bundler && npm run typecheck:nodenext
scripts.smoke: npm ci && npm run prepare:tarball && npm run playwright:install && npm run build:app && npm run test:e2e
